scope: Ringve Music Museum’s main manor house, Hovedbygningen, as seen in September 2009 before the 2015 fire. Includes the long wooden range, projecting garden room, two unequal towers, and attached entrances at either end. The separate stable, Wessel building, arboretum and exhibition interiors are outside this model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Museum conservator describes east-west main wing, a garden room extending south, an open lookout tower, a lower stair tower, enclosed garden veranda and the later attached gable stairways.
Museum documents the August 2015 fire, the long history of the original timber house and its subsequent restoration.
